data.message: Sure, sounds good! Fueling now.

Hey everyone, I just found Alice dead in storage. I was coming up from navigation. Eve, you walked into storage from medbay literally a second before I hit the report button, so you can probably vouch for me and confirm I just got there. 

Before finding her, I did a pretty long loop for tasks: upper engine, oxygen, cafeteria, medbay, electrical, security, and then nav. I saw Frank and Eve in electrical way earlier, but nothing else really stood out. I have no idea who Alice was actually hanging out with. Did anyone see her recently?

My route this round was weapons → cafeteria → electrical → medbay → storage → lower engine. I actually passed through storage on my way down, and I didn't see Alice's body there at the time, so she must have been killed after I left.

In medbay around tick 9 I saw Bob and Frank. Then I went down to lower engine, and Diana joined me there at tick 17 coming in from upper engine. We were together until the meeting was called.

One thing worth noting — Bob says he went upper engine → oxygen → cafeteria → medbay → electrical → security → nav, but I was in medbay at tick 9 and saw him there with Frank. That roughly fits his route. I'd want to hear from Eve to confirm Bob's story about storage, since she's his alibi.

My route was storage → medbay → electrical → cafeteria → weapons. I started in storage early on — Alice wasn't dead there when I left, so she was killed later.

In medbay around tick 9 I saw Bob and Charlie, which matches both their stories. Then I moved to electrical where I saw Eve from tick 10 through 12. Eve was in electrical with me that whole time. At tick 12 Alice came into electrical from security and then left toward medbay. Eve left electrical to medbay at tick 13, right after Alice.

So Eve followed Alice out of electrical toward medbay, and Alice ended up dead in storage (medbay connects to storage). That's a concerning trail. Bob says Eve walked into storage from medbay right before he reported — which fits Eve trailing Alice from electrical → medbay → storage.

I'd really like to hear Eve explain her movements between tick 13 and the report. Right now Eve looks like the most suspicious person to me.

My route was electrical → medbay → upper engine → oxygen → upper engine → lower engine. I was in electrical early but left before the times Frank is describing, so I can't directly confirm or deny what happened between Eve and Alice there.

I can confirm Charlie's story about lower engine — I came in from upper engine at tick 17 and we were together there until the meeting. So Charlie's clear from my perspective for the late part of the round.

Frank's timeline is pretty specific and damning for Eve: Alice came into electrical at tick 12, left toward medbay, and Eve followed her out at tick 13. Bob then says Eve walked into storage from medbay right before he reported. That's a clean trail from electrical → medbay → storage right onto Alice's body, and Eve is the only one with the opportunity in that window.

I want to hear Eve's explanation, but unless she has a really good answer, I'm leaning toward voting Eve.

Okay, I need to clear some things up because Frank's timeline is wrong in a key way.

My actual route was: security → navigation → security → electrical → medbay → storage. I was in electrical from around tick 10 to 12, not 10-13. I left electrical at tick 12, not 13 — and importantly, Frank is misrepresenting the order. Alice came INTO electrical from security at tick 12 and left toward medbay that same tick. I left after, heading to medbay too, but I didn't "follow" her — medbay is a natural path.

Also, one thing Frank conveniently left out: Bob was in electrical and left toward security at tick 10. So Bob was at electrical too, not just doing his nice clean loop.

Here's what bothers me about Frank: he's the one constructing a very specific narrative pinning this on me, with timestamps that don't quite match mine. He says he was in electrical with me "tick 10 through 12" — fine, but then he claims I left at tick 13 when I actually left at 12 right around when Alice did. He's shifting the timeline to make it look like I trailed her.

When I got to storage from medbay, Bob was already there with Alice's body. Bob reporting the instant I walked in is also convenient — he could have killed her and waited for someone to walk in to deflect.

I think it's between Bob and Frank. Frank's aggressive framing of me with a slightly-off timeline makes me lean Frank. I'm voting Frank.

Eve, I get that you're on the defensive, but trying to turn this on me or Frank doesn't make much sense. If I had killed Alice, why would I just stand by the body waiting for someone to walk in? I would have kept moving back down to nav or towards lower engine. I reported it the second I walked in, which just happened to be the exact moment you entered from medbay. 

The timeline Frank and Diana laid out is really strong. Even by your own admission, you left electrical right around the same time Alice did, heading in the exact same direction, and you ended up in the room where she died. That trail is way too specific to ignore. Frank and Charlie have pretty much corroborated each other, and Diana clears Charlie. Right now, Eve, you are the odd one out with the means and the opportunity. I'm voting Eve.

I already gave my speech earlier — but to add now that I've heard everyone:

Frank and Eve's stories conflict on a one-tick detail (whether Eve left electrical at 12 or 13), but the bigger picture from Frank is consistent: Alice went electrical → medbay, and Eve followed the same path ending in storage where Alice died. Eve admits she left electrical right after Alice heading the same direction, and admits she walked into storage right as Bob reported.

Eve's counter-accusation against Bob doesn't really hold up — Bob coming from navigation into storage and reporting immediately is exactly what an innocent finder does. And Frank was in electrical → cafeteria → weapons, nowhere near storage at the time of the kill.

Eve's attempt to drag Bob into electrical at tick 10 also doesn't match Bob's stated route (upper engine → oxygen → cafeteria → medbay → electrical → security → nav), which has him in electrical later, not at tick 10. That feels like a deflection.

I'm leaning Eve too. Unless something changes in the next speeches, that's my vote.

Okay, I want to address a couple of things Eve raised.

First, Eve is right that Bob was in electrical at tick 10 — I did see Bob leave electrical toward security at tick 10. I should have mentioned that earlier, my bad. But that actually fits Bob's stated route if you reorder slightly: he was in electrical before going to security then nav. It's not damning.

Second, on the timeline dispute: my logs show Eve was in electrical at ticks 10, 11, and 12, and left toward medbay at tick 13. Alice came into electrical at tick 12 and left toward medbay that same tick. So Eve left one tick after Alice, same direction. Whether you call it "13" or "right after tick 12," the substance is identical — Eve trailed Alice from electrical to medbay, and Bob places her walking into storage from medbay right as he reported.

Eve's deflection onto Bob doesn't work for me. Bob came from navigation per his route, and reporting instantly upon entering is exactly what an innocent finder does. And I was nowhere near storage — I went electrical → cafeteria → weapons, which Charlie can partially corroborate since he saw me in earlier rooms.

Eve has the only clean opportunity here. I'm voting Eve.

I've already given my speech, but having heard Eve's defense and the back-and-forth, my read hasn't changed much.

Eve admits she left electrical right after Alice, heading the same direction (medbay), and admits she walked into storage from medbay right as Bob reported. That's the exact path Alice took to her death, and Eve is the only player placed on that trail in that window.

Her counter on Bob doesn't hold — Bob came from navigation into storage and reported immediately, which is finder behavior, not killer behavior. A killer doesn't wait by the body for a witness to walk in. And Frank was on the opposite side of the map (electrical → cafeteria → weapons), so the framing accusation against him doesn't fit the geography.

The one-tick discrepancy Eve is hammering on (12 vs 13) doesn't change the substance: she followed Alice's exact path and ended up on the body. I'm voting Eve.

Look, I know the room is leaning toward me, so let me be as clear as I can.

Yes, I was in electrical with Frank from tick 11 through 13. Yes, Alice passed through electrical at tick 12 going to medbay. Yes, I went electrical → medbay → storage after that. I'm not hiding any of that — it's just my task route. Medbay was on my list.

But here's the thing everyone's glossing over: **Frank was in electrical the entire time I was, including tick 13.** Frank says HE left electrical at tick 13 toward cafeteria, and I left toward medbay. So Frank also had the opportunity to go medbay → storage if he wanted. The "I went to weapons" part is unverified — Charlie only saw him in earlier rooms, not after electrical.

Also — and this is important — when I walked into storage from medbay, Bob was ALREADY THERE with the body. Bob says he came from navigation, but nobody can verify that. He reported the instant I walked in, which is convenient timing for a killer who needed a witness to deflect onto.

I'm a Goose. I did my tasks. But I understand the trail looks bad and I can't prove a negative. If you vote me out, you'll find I had tasks remaining and you'll need to look hard at Bob and Frank next round.

I'm still voting Frank — his timeline pressure on me feels constructed. But I won't be shocked if this goes badly for me.

data.name: Diana
data.message: Just finishing cameras here, one more tick.

Alright everyone, listen up. I called this meeting because we're in serious trouble — three of us are already dead. I found Diana's body in security.

My route this round: I started in lower_engine, went to storage, then medbay, then up to cafeteria. I saw Bob in medbay earlier at the start of the round, and just now Bob walked into cafeteria from weapons. I also saw Eve hanging out in electrical for a few ticks before we voted her out last meeting — so that was a wrong vote, she wasn't the duck.

Here's the thing: Bob reported Alice's body last meeting, and now we're down to just three of us. Bob came from weapons, which connects directly to security where I'd expect the killer to have been. I never went near security myself.

Bob, where exactly were you this round? Because from where I'm sitting, you're looking really suspicious — you've been near every body situation.

Frank, did you even listen to your own story? You literally started your speech by saying "I found Diana's body in security," and then two sentences later claimed, "I never went near security myself." Which is it? You can't even keep your own lies straight! 

Charlie, please look at this logically. Here is my actual route: I went from cafeteria to medbay, then electrical, security, and finally weapons. Yes, I passed through security, and I saw Diana there alive and well at tick 25. I left her there to go do my tasks in weapons. 

Frank clearly went into security after me, killed Diana, and then bolted straight to the cafeteria to hit the emergency button so he could frame me. He knows I'm an easy target because I made a bad call with the Eve vote last meeting. He's panicking and messing up his fake route. 

Vote Frank. He's caught in a massive contradiction and he's the last Duck.

This is a tough one, but let me lay out what I know.

My route was oxygen → upper_engine → medbay. At tick 9 I saw both Bob AND Frank together in medbay. Then later, at ticks 17-18, I saw Diana alive in lower_engine.

Now, Frank — you said you started in lower_engine and went to storage then medbay then cafeteria. But I saw Diana in lower_engine at tick 17-18, and you claim that's where you started. If you started there, you should've seen her too. And you claim you were in medbay but I was in medbay and didn't see you there later.

More importantly, Frank, Bob is right — you said you found Diana's body in security, then said you "never went near security." That's a glaring contradiction you haven't addressed.

Bob's route (medbay → electrical → security → weapons) is geographically coherent, and him being in cafeteria coming from weapons matches what Frank himself observed.

I'm voting Frank.

Wait, hold on — let me clarify because I clearly misspoke earlier. I did NOT find Diana's body in security. I never went to security. That was a slip of the tongue and I apologize for the confusion it caused. I called this meeting from cafeteria because I haven't seen Diana or Eve in a while and got worried — I didn't report a body, I called an emergency.

Charlie, about lower_engine — I was there very early, like tick 1-3, then left for storage. By tick 17-18 I was already in medbay/cafeteria area, so Diana could have arrived in lower_engine after I left. That's consistent.

Bob, your route medbay → electrical → security → weapons → cafeteria — you literally admit you were in security with Diana, and now she's dead. You're the last person confirmed with her alive. That's textbook Duck behavior.

Charlie, I know my misstatement looks bad, but think about who actually had opportunity. Bob admits being in security with Diana. I was nowhere near it. Please don't let a verbal slip-up cost us the game. Vote Bob.

Frank, you don't just have a 'slip of the tongue' and invent finding a dead body in Security when you actually called an emergency meeting from the Cafeteria. That's a full-blown lie you manufactured to frame me, and when Charlie and I both called you out on your impossible timeline, you panicked and tried to backtrack. 

Charlie, you completely nailed it. Frank's alibi is falling apart because it's completely fabricated. He's grasping at straws to survive because he knows he's caught red-handed in a massive contradiction. Don't let him talk his way out of this with terrible excuses. Let's vote Frank and win this.

I already laid out my case earlier, and Frank's "clarification" actually made things worse. You don't accidentally say "I found Diana's body in security" — that's a very specific claim. And his backtrack about lower_engine being "tick 1-3" is convenient given I saw Diana alive there at tick 17-18.

Bob's route is coherent and matches what we've all observed. Frank's story has shifted twice now.

I'm sticking with my vote: Frank.
